column3: what a person found when reading (BM16, 2026-11-08). Edit here, then re-run node scripts/requirements-register.mjs
(BM18 closed) Clocks are shown and tested, but nothing detects that the phone's or the ship's zone changed and tells the guest. No such wording anywhere in src or the strings file.
(BM18 closed) No statement that crew instructions and announcements override app content, on the muster card or anywhere else.
Boarded is a time the guest types (EmbarkState.boardedAt in src/domain/embark.ts). No source field, no manifest or scan status from the server.
(BM18 closed) No wording or state separating the guest's departure preference from the assignment made by operations.
No fare or terms version is stored at checkout. Only legal documents are versioned (dbo.Acceptances has Version).
Refund timing appears as fact ("Refunds reach your card in 5 working days", hub.portSkipped.comp.arrives), not labelled as an estimate.
Outcomes are worded after a case is resolved (case.outcome.refunded). No wording at submission that opening a case does not mean the charge is reversed.
trustLedger has a refund kind, but folio.ts has no pending, disputed, refunded or adjusted line state; the final bill only adjusts the tip.
Sign-in, recovery and lockout exist. No sign-out-everywhere endpoint or device list; the server field Users.SessionsValidFrom is set only by a password reset. No step-up check found.
No redaction rule found for push title and body (PushNotice has Title and Body). Documents are access-scoped on the server.
src/domain/assistance.ts has no owner or team and no "reason no ETA". RequestsScreen may carry them; read it.
Escalation and reopen not found in the aboard request screen or domain; the /me/fix-cases endpoint has escalate. Read RequestsScreen and the server request model.
No wording distinguishing planned from confirmed items in plan.ts or WeekPlanner.tsx.
No per-field saved, submitted or accepted state found in the check-in steps.
LedgerKind lists payment, charge, credit, covered, refund. The nine states (draft to failed) are not found as one type; check StatusBadge.
(BM18 closed) HistoryScreen has no search or filter; trips are listed, receipts shown.
(BM18 closed) No Princess-operated versus independent label found in PortCard or excursions.ts.
ChatSafe has a photo minimum age. No age-aware message rule found in the client; check ChatService.cs.
See IDN-01.

(BM20) SlotWatch is a dinner/show/tour cancellation watch, not a sailing, fare or availability alert with a threshold and price context. priceCalendar has no alert. Stop exists; no pause.
(BM20) LoyaltyScreen shows tier, days and perks; no last-sync time, stale flag or way to report a discrepancy.
(BM20) Only a credit mention in PerksPanel; no credit wallet with source, expiry, eligibility or redemption history found in LoyaltyScreen or PerksPanel.
(BM20) excursions.ts has minAge and accessible, excursionFit has wheelchair; no exertion level and no "operator to confirm" flag found for uncertain accessibility.
(BM20) Venue directory shows open or closed from hours (openAt) only: no temporarily-unavailable state and no timestamp.
(BM20) src/ai has no source or freshness label on answers.
(BM20) readinessBoard rows carry name, percent, open tasks and behind flag only; no document fields.
(BM20) ledgerSplit is a shared-expense settle-up between families, not invited-payer contributions to a booking with per-payer amount, deadline and paid, pending or failed status.
(BM20) arrivalPing derives a follower line from ship stage; meetingPoint has "I'm here" wording but no expiry after embarkation found. No one-time departed or arrived signal.
(BM20) searchIndex returns hits that link to screens (title, detail, to); no direct answers or actions and no source or freshness.
(BM20) storm.ts is a storm likelihood reading; neither it nor whatIf.ts lists impacted reservations or proposes alternatives.
(BM20) MedallionScreen has activate and lost; no order or delivery status found, but ReadyScreens.tsx was only skimmed.
(BM20) groupBoard.ts and GroupBoard.tsx have no close-voting step and no export of the result (the only "export" matches are the TypeScript keyword).
(BM20) countdowns.ts covers boarding, final payment and check-in opening only; no documents, excursions or special requests, and no event history when a deadline changes.
(BM20) entitlements.ts has balance and used; no usage window or expiry, and no history of expired items.
(BM20) tickets.ts and Tickets.tsx have no accessibility accommodation request or status.
(BM20) sync.ts is a versioned per-key document store with conflict on a second device; which keys are bound was not checked.
(BM20) ClubsScreen has no guardian wording; ahead.ts has consent and age constants but they were not read in full.
(BM20) The only consent in ahead.ts is marketing double opt-in; ClubsScreen and ahead.ts have no guardian consent or sign-in/out authority wording.
(BM20) RequestsScreen shows status; no photo attachment, preferred-contact or duplicate-case guard found.
(BM20) RebookScreen shows no reason for a recommendation and no editable inputs (search found none).
(BM20) AssistanceScreen and medicalCard have no recipient preview, revoke or acknowledgement.
(BM20) travel.ts has no provider, reference or contact fields found; only a "booked with" note.
(BM20) BM19 added export and restore of waiting items and unreadable-store handling (deviceBackup).
(BM20) Flight step exists in OnwardScreen; link targets and credential handling not read.
(BM20) A card exists in finishMore.ts; print and cache behaviour not read.
